integrity: Exact Hilbert-space proof and a finite supplementary checker; no numerical search is used to establish infinite-dimensional or global claims.
scientific_limitations: The displayed parameter interval is sufficient rather than sharp; at least three, not exactly three, global mean classes are established. The true global minimum, algorithm basins, alternative parameterizations and joint-realizability of all three sample loops in one common polynomial flow are not determined. Independent mathematical validation and exhaustive historical priority assessment are outstanding.
title: A metastable circular mean and threefold global nonuniqueness for embedded periodic trajectories
